title: Density measures and applications
summary: The paper, that continuous some previous work of Schönherr & Schuricht, treats density measures on ${\mathbb R}^n$ that concentrate in any neighborhood of a Lebesgue null set. Such measures are typical for purely finitely additive measures. We study their basic properties and investigate related integrals. Measures taking only the values 0 and 1 are considered as special case. The results are first applied to weak convergence in $\mathcal{L}^\infty(Ω)$.
